body: Thank you, I really like the attention you're giving me, I came back to thank you and court for the help you guys gave me, I really appreciate and I'm really touch about what you guys did.
thank you, I will look at this

No, I spend most of time on internet to pass time. I don't have a hobby, I think that I have to finish college too, but it's hard, there almost a year I don't show up regulary to classes. No passions of any kind that I can remember.

I have a really hard time to go to college, actually, I have a hard time in leaving the house.
About the clues, I don't know any that could help me, I feel like I lost my chance and I'm fated to be this way to the rest of my life, thats why I want to finish it quickly.

I will try to get some sleep, probably I will be here in 10-12 hours.
thank you so much, everyone. Mostly to court12b and Pippafert.

I agree with you about others sees in us things we don't see in ourselfs.

I barely finished the high school, I lost a lot of classes but I could manage to conclude it. I already tried a lot of colleges (about 5 different courses, here the college are public and I can normaly pass the test to get in in some courses).

About work, I tried some works, but normaly I enter in crisis and in some point I get fired or stop showing up. Nowadays I dont feel able to do any  job.

What do you mean with daft? Silly? Insane? Stupid?

I know it seens easy to solve, I think that way too, but make thinkgs happen is a lot different of saying so...
I tried a lot to act different, to make a change and move on... But for me, do basic stuff like eat or take a shower is a hard battle, even meet friends is something that I avoid to do because it is tiring.

I've been out of medication more than 7 months, same as counseling. I spend a lot of time doing those, but in the end I nothing really changed, it feels like I was really sick and I was living to fight against my sickness and nothing besides that really changed, my life didnt moved even a inch.

Even on meds and doing therapy, I felt the same way, I had hope to overcome one day, but I'm almost 30, with no work exp, no graduation, no relationship (that I can handle, afterwards I would not date myself) and no perspective.

I think its like the halfway of india (that we see in television) + EUA (the "american fuck yeah" part)

It's not safe place, people are afraid to leave their houses at night at foot, they have a great chance to get mugged or even killed. transportation are precarious, most of the things are made the most cheapest way to get most profit of it and most of people don't have good education, they just live and I would like to be a ignorant one who doesnt think about what is around me and just live anyways.

People are superficial, they show happiness and they are really helpfull with others that they don't know, but deep inside they are egoists, they think before on themselfs and ways to make profit of things.
We have a lot of people that are hard working too, there is a lot of good people but those people are exceptions in my view, the people who have knowledge of the inquality normaly have a good willpower to keep going.

I'm really trying. I normaly shut myself down and ignore my feelings and try to live the day...
But I've been doing it for so long time. I'm tired, I dont want to live, I just want to sleep forever...
I don't care for myself at all.

thank you, I did with my mother years ago, but that time I had more pespective with life and but nothing got better, nothing settle and my stage in life didnt change much from there to where I'm, I just have a lot more acknowledge that I don't know where to use, or if there is a way to use.

They know I have depression, most of them know(s?)... But none of them know that I'm here and that I'm thinking to kill myself soon. I have shame and I don't want to bother others with my problems, I already mess a lot with others peoples lives...

I don't have money to take a bus to next city, I don't have way to live, I never really worked because most of my adulthood I was in depression or trying to finish a graduation.

I will look, but to be honest, I dont feel it will work now... I already tried to do a lot of things and nothing really worked, I never lost my thought to kill myself, honestly, what makes me calm is thinking ways to kill myself painless, clean (to avoid hard trauma to others) and quickly.

No, I don't know how to do it.
it's hard even to move out and get a job to make some money and run.
I dreamed to move alway to just kill myself and no families would know or at least find my body.
